selection: Union of the first ten genes in the saved full ranking, two genes ahead of BUB1B in the original no-ClinVar ablation, and the earlier SMC5 hypothesis. Frozen before fetching the alternatives' population data. This is a selected-gene audit, not a genome-wide population reannotation.
frequency_policy: Prefer supplied PASS joint AC/AN. If joint data are missing or filtered, use the maximum valid PASS exome/genome AF. Preserve every source count, flags and ancestry group. Do not add exome/genome counts manually. Unmatched, invalid, zero-AN or wholly filtered records remain unknown, never zero.
ancestry_sensitivity: Also compare maximum observed AF across standard ancestry groups (afr, ami, amr, asj, eas, fin, mid, nfe, sas), excluding remaining and the aggregate row. No patient ancestry is inferred. Preserve denominators and filtering AF; low-count group maxima can be unstable.
scoring: Retain the original generic prioritization thresholds: AF <0.001 contributes +1; AF >0.01 excludes the allele. These are research triage thresholds, not disease-specific ACMG criteria. Rarity alone does not classify pathogenicity.
privacy: Requests contain public gene IDs and dataset name, no sample identifiers, genotypes, candidate allele lists or clinical document. Candidate matching and comparisons run locally. Gene selection reflects the analysis; this is not a claim of fully bulk or query-independent reference acquisition.
